title: Two parallel PRs merging the same backlog id turned main's validate red for every PR
problem: Backlog ids are 'the next free number', taken from each run's own clone. PRs #18882 and #18884 both took P075; each PR's CI was green because neither saw the other, and once both merged `promptctl validate` failed on main, so the required Prompts check went red on every later PR touching prompts/, and several runs each spent time renumbering the same file in parallel (only one rename survived the merges).
evidence: 11 run records from 2026-11-25 mention P075 together with duplicate/renumber/P076 (grep -l P075 prompts/runs/2026-11-25*.json | xargs grep -l -i 'duplicate|renumber|P076|collid')
platform/ci/friction_rank.py --live --ungated --days 3: clusters 'prompts/process/backlog/' (3 sessions) and 'prompts/process/backlog/README.md' (2 sessions), both 2026-11-25
change: validate fails only a branch that adds a duplicate id (PR CI: files the merge commit adds over its main parent, prompts-ci.yml now fetches depth 2; session: over origin/main; unknown: the old strict check). A duplicate both of whose files are already on main is a warning from validate and a line in `backlog`, which any run can fix by renumbering, so it no longer blocks unrelated PRs.
metric: run records whose errors or doc_friction say main's validate was red on a duplicate backlog id, or that renumbered one, per week
